assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: premium skincare website HERO photograph, landscape 3:2. Create a photorealistic luxury beauty editorial still life for FORME. Architectural warm ivory limestone plinths in a sunlit taupe studio, dramatic soft-edged diagonal shadows. LEFT HALF and upper area remain softly shadowed warm neutral empty space for website text to be overlaid separately. No background text. 85mm medium format photography, restrained editorial art direction, real material textures, no flowers, no leaves, no decorative objects, no watermarks. Colors warm ivory #F1EEE7, charcoal #262722, taupe. Not a website mockup, purely a photograph.
